headline: US Crude Oil Imports from Venezuela Reach Highest Level Since 2017 in July
summary: U.S. imports of crude oil from Venezuela averaged 701,000 barrels per day in July 2026, marking the highest volume since May 2017 before declining to 655,000 barrels per day in August.
why: The U.S. Energy Information Administration provides official energy statistics and analysis for the United States, tracking petroleum supply and trade flows that influence global energy markets.

impacts.name: WTI crude
impacts.why: Increased physical crude oil imports from Venezuela alter supply levels in the United States.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An increase in crude oil imports into the U.S. from Venezuela shifts supply dynamics in the North American petroleum market.
